name: Aggression
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of aggression but calls believers to respond with courage and righteousness rather than violence. Jesus' example in cleansing the temple shows righteous zeal against sin, yet He also teaches restraint by warning that those who live by the sword will perish by it. God ordains governing authorities to bear the sword for justice and to punish evil, underscoring that aggression without divine sanction leads to judgment. Ultimately, believers are called to be peacemakers who shine as lights through their good works, reflecting God's character even amid conflict.
